in_sanskrit.name: Gani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Soldier, Warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gana’ meaning ‘group’ or ‘army’, Gani is a powerful and evocative name for a boy in Hindu culture. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, is also known as ‘Gana-Pati’, the leader of the Ganas, or the army of gods.
